Together with corticosteroids, derivatives of 5-aminosalicylic acid are one of the mainstays of the treatment of inflammatory bowel disease (p.1697). However, aminosalicylic acid (4-aminosalicylic acid) has also been inves- tigated, and beneficial results have been reported with both enemas1-4 and oral dose forms5 in ulcerative colitis. Three pa- tients who developed acute pancreatitis while taking mesalazine (5-aminosalicylic acid) for inflammatory bowel disease, later tol- erated treatment with 4-aminosalicylic acid enemas.6 1.
